N1.s: %lld ücretsiz Cutling’inizi kullandınız. Cutling’de devam edip kilidi açtığınızda bu da saklanır.
N1.back: 5 free Cutling-your-(acc.) you-used. Cutling-in continuing lock-the when-you-open this too is-kept.
N1.why: First sentence is S3's word for word so the limit always has the same name; "bu da" (this one too) points at the item Siri was saving, and "-tığınızda" (when you) keeps it an outcome, not a condition; 94 characters.

N2.s: %lld ücretsiz Cutling’inizi kullandınız. Daha fazla saklamak için kilidi Cutling’den açın.
N2.back: 5 free Cutling-your-(acc.) you-used. More to-keep for lock-the Cutling-from open-you.
N2.why: The ablative "Cutling’den açın" is how Turkish says do it from inside an app (as in "Ayarlar’dan açın"), which avoids the clumsy "Cutling’i açıp kilidini açın" with two opens; 87 characters.

N3.why: Two short facts joined by a comma as a Turkish speaker would say them; "ücretsiz yer" is K1's slot word; no placeholder exists, so the digit is fixed; exactly 30 characters.

N4.why: After the dot comes S29's own label, so the keyboard shows the same "5/5 ücretsiz" the main screen shows and 5/5 says full without a verb; "ücretsiz yer dolu" ran to 31; 23 characters.

N5.s: %lld/%lld dolu · Kilidi açın, bu da saklansın
N5.back: 5/5 full · Lock-the open-you, this too let-it-be-kept
N5.why: Ends on the imperative "Kilidi açın" like K1 so the bar reads as something to tap, and "bu da saklansın" says the item waits; "ücretsiz yer" dropped because N4 named it one save earlier and 40 would not hold it; 39 characters.

N6.why: The same title-case button verb as S15, so the Share sheet and the unlock sheet use one word; 9 characters.

N7.s: %lld ücretsiz Cutling’inizi kullandınız. Cutling’in kilidini açtığınızda bu da saklanır.
N7.back: 5 free Cutling-your-(acc.) you-used. Cutling-of lock-its when-you-open this too is-kept.
N7.why: S3's first sentence again, then S28's "Cutling’in kilidini" because this row sits inside another app and has to name whose lock; same "bu da saklanır" ending as N1; 85 characters.

N8.s: Bu Cutling sizi bekliyor. Kilidi Cutling’den açtığınızda saklanır.
N8.back: This Cutling you-(acc.) is-waiting. Lock-the Cutling-from when-you-open it-is-kept.
N8.why: "Sizi bekliyor" (it is waiting for you) is the warm everyday way to say something is held, and matches the dashed tile waiting on the unlock sheet; "Cutling’den" repeats N2's open-from-the-app phrase; 66 characters.
